column1: # DEV-MODE roster: two 10-ship fleets of different doctrines, opposite sides, one system.
# Pick a low-sec or null-sec home system (--home): hunters fight only where there is no law.
# red: Rifters (projectile guns); blue: Merlins (hybrid guns). Boss = first bot of a group.
# roam: a gang of 6 on its own side (hostile to both): the FC (roam1) stages, the fastest hull scouts the
# neighbouring systems, and the body engages together once a scout reports a fight it clears the bar for.
# Needs a gate map (--content) and --society-pvp; set --roster-home to a low-sec or null-sec system.
# capital pair (CAP-DOCTRINE #35): a dreadnought pilot and its cyno alt on the red side. DEV roster: dev mode grants the
# hull and fuel, for CI and soak only. In society play a capital is never granted: it is flown only from a hull a builder made
# or an NPC dropped (`doctrine::Role::Capital`, `doctrine_assign::seat_open`). The capital row and the cyno-alt row after it
# are one pair, bot by bot. The alt flies a hull the cynosural generator fits (a force recon ship; [A] the first published
# generator's canFitShipGroup list names that group; falsified by a dev kit line naming the generator as refused).
